text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Daiichi Ruby achieved a mother-daughter 
sweep of the Oka Sho. With expectations 
mounting for her to avenge her mother at 
the Yushun Himba, the pressure grows.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Meanwhile, Daitaku Helios, who adored her, 
was further captivated by her running. She 
lamented that they couldn't race together 
due to running on different routes.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The next goal is the second leg of the 
Triple Tiara route, the Oaks. A 2,400m 
middle-distance race is an unfamiliar 
distance to herâ

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Even so, Daiichi Ruby stated there was no 
problem. Refusing to let down her guard 
after the win, she began training for the 
Oaks.
